svg.title: Ask User: the model asks multiple-choice questions mid-run
svg.desc: The model calls ask_user_question with one to ten multiple-choice questions. AskUser validates them, rejecting calls outside the limits or with control characters as a retry, then hands an AskUserRequest to the answerer you supply, such as a terminal menu or a web form. The answerer returns an AskUserResponse. The model gets the picked labels keyed by header, a sentence saying the user declined or did not answer in time, or, with answerer=None, the run pauses with DeferredToolRequests until you answer in a later run.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
